description: Cross-corpus resistant-source regression: Geviert-origin operator must transfer to differential and asymmetric cases, preserve local mode variation, and remain inactive on a cogito negative control.

corpora.label: Heidegger Geviert origin case
corpora.rationale: Origin case: source resists relata-first representation and ties gathering to preserved distance.

corpora.label: Saussure value and difference transfer
corpora.rationale: Independent transfer: differential value tests whether source-driven relation genesis generalizes beyond Heidegger without importing Fourfold vocabulary.

corpora.label: Spinoza substance-mode asymmetry
corpora.rationale: Non-collapse control: the operator may activate only if it preserves one-way dependence and priority rather than forcing reciprocal co-constitution.

corpora.label: Aristotle primary substance and relatives
corpora.rationale: Mixed-regime control: primary-substance priority and the category of relatives must not be flattened into one global relation ontology.

corpora.label: Descartes cogito negative control
corpora.rationale: Negative control: philosophical centrality and occasional dependence language must not activate relation-genesis when the local explanandum is cogito certainty and thinking selfhood.
